task: A baseline Zoom config file exists at /home/user/.config/zoomus.conf. Change mirrorMyVideo to false to disable the mirror effect on your video preview. Save the file in-place at /home/user/.config/zoomus.conf. Do not modify any other keys.

cli_feasibility.translation: Use sed to modify /home/user/.config/zoomus.conf: set [Video] mirrorMyVideo=false
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI agent can directly edit the config file using sed. Single boolean value change is trivial for CLI. Task mentions GUI but CLI is equally viable.
